title: Never Back Down Super PAC for Ron DeSantis Uses AI [person] Voice in Attack Ad Against [person]

behaviors.text: A pro-Ron DeSantis super PAC released an ad featuring an AI-generated voice of [person].
The ad, created by Never Back Down, aimed to criticize [person]’s treatment of Iowa Gov.
The AI-generated voice was confirmed to be based on [person]'s post from his social media.
This incident is an example of potential deception in political advertising through AI-generated content.
